name: stock_valuation
summary: Valuation layers with FIFO and moving-average costing, landed costs and a GL outbox
description: Immutable valuation layers posted from the move ledger in integer cents: FIFO consumption allocates oldest remaining layers first, moving average blends on receipt; landed costs distribute freight/duty by quantity, weight, volume or value with deterministic remainder handling; late costs adjust remaining layers or raise a COGS correction. Accounting integration is publish-only through a valuation event outbox - Accounting owns journals (blueprint section 10).
author: Nexa
